entries.ownerRules: capital Guatemala City.

entries.ownerRules: capital Bridgetown. drives on the left.

entries.name: Cuba
entries.ownerRules: capital Havana. Neutral wording.

entries.ownerRules: name "Dominican Republic", capital Santo Domingo.

entries.ownerRules: capital Kingston; languages English. drives on the left. The flag is the only national flag without red, white or blue: say so.

entries.name: Bolivia
entries.ownerRules: capital EXACTLY "Sucre (constitutional capital), La Paz (seat of government)", quizCapital "Sucre". Languages: the constitution makes Spanish and 36 indigenous languages official; list Spanish, Quechua, Aymara, Guaraní and say in the note that 36 indigenous languages are official in all.

entries.ownerRules: capital Quito; currency EXACTLY "US Dollar (US$)"; languages Spanish (Kichwa and Shuar are official for intercultural relations: note only).
